incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate detected for service inference-api-prod (hosted). Trigger: 5xx ratio > 10% over 1m. Pager: SRE oncall. Link: https://ops.redwood.ai/incidents/1850002468
Alex H: I'm on it, joining war room https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/1850002468
Priya K: Taking ownership for customer comms. Will draft status page + outgoing email.
Jorge M: Quick note — Dedicated customers seem unaffected; looks like traffic is concentrated on the hosted runtime pool in us-east-1.
Alex H: Confirming, seeing increased 503s from frontend logs; kv cache timeouts -> model-serving RPC errors.
Alex H: Running quick healthcheck and restarting one of the gateway pods now:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/inference-gateway-prod
kubectl -n inference get pods -o wide | grep gateway
```
Priya K: Draft for internal status page: "Investigating - Elevated errors on Hosted API affecting a subset of requests. Engineers investigating. No ETA yet." Good?
CustomerOps: For external status page keep it short and non-technical. Suggest: "We are investigating increased errors and latency for the Hosted Redwood API. Some requests may fail or be slow. We will update shortly."
Priya K: Sending initial external: "Investigating - We are aware of increased errors (5xx) and elevated latency in the hosted inference API. We're actively investigating and will post updates every 30 minutes." Scheduling outbound to impacted customers now.
PagerDuty: Oncall acknowledged. Escalation to SRE Lead (Jorge M) in +8m if unresolved.
Jorge M: Alex, any signs of OOM or network saturation on model nodes?
Alex H: Model nodes memory steady. I see RPC timeouts between gateway and cache layer (redis cluster). Rotate one cache pod as mitigation.
Alex H: Mitigation steps: rotated 2/3 cache replicas, cleared stale connections, increased redis client timeout temporarily. Error rate dropped 12% -> ~4% over 8 minutes.
Priya K: Draft customer update: "Mitigated - error rates have decreased following a cache node rotation. Customers may still see intermittent failures; we are monitoring closely and will follow up with a root cause report." Approve to publish? :thumbsup:
CustomerOps: Publish and tag impacted hosted-plan customers. Notify account teams.
incident-bot: War room created by Alex H — https://meet.redwood.ai/warroom/1850002468. Severity set to Sev2. Incident doc created: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/1850002468
Alex H: I'll own technical remediation/RCAs. Priya, can you own customer communications and status updates? Need final post-incident note + timeline.
Priya K: Yes. Drafting post-incident note: will include timeline, affected endpoints, mitigation, and planned hardening (cache connection backoffs, client timeouts). ETA for draft: 6 hours.
Jorge M: Heads up — I'm stepping out in ~25m. If error rate creeps back >8% re-escalate to SRE Lead.
Alex H: Acknowledged. Handing comms owner to Priya at 02:00Z. I remain technical owner until RCA complete.
Priya K: Confirmed. I'll update status page every 30m and coordinate the external customer note.
CustomerOps: Please add a short blurb for account teams: "Impacted: Hosted API (text-generation). Not impacted: Dedicated, Private deployments."
Alex H: Adding quick runbook snippet to incident doc:
```
check-gateway-health: curl -sS https://inference-api-prod/health | jq .
rotate-cache: kubectl -n inference rollout restart statefulset/redis-cache-prod
```
Priya K: Once RCAs are ready we'll include mitigation plan and timeline for preventing recurrence.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE ANNOTATION — last_message_ts=1850004320. Thread will remain open for followups, but owners and handoffs noted above.
